_tuning_notes: Mountain gorilla: windswept hills + grove, thicker fur texture, +4 health over lowland, slightly smaller troops. Proves biome-tag species routing from the same entity class. Phase 3: forage block = melon/berry raids (mobGriefing-gated); a fed troop is 'content' for content_minutes: taming chance doubles (2/3), chest-beat cooldown doubles, roaming calms. cage_tier 2 = reinforced cage required. Phase 3.1: fur is a per-individual pick from the 'textures' list (stable per entity); the silverback saddle is a translucent overlay layer, so it composes with every fur colour instead of needing a silverback copy of each.
guide_blurb: Thicker coat, thinner air, same rules.
